HomePage.title: Voley Lisboa
HomePage.intro: Log in or create your player account to manage games in Lisbon.

TutorialPage.title: Get started with Voley Lisboa
TutorialPage.intro: Create your account, choose how you want to use the app, and enable notifications so you do not miss a game.
TutorialPage.accountIntro: Use your name and email address to create an account. We will send a 6-digit code to confirm your sign-in. After your first sign-in, open your profile to add a picture.
TutorialPage.accessIntro: You can open Voley Lisboa in your browser whenever you need it. Installing the app on your phone also lets you receive game and open-slot notifications.
TutorialPage.browserDescription: Use whichever browser you prefer. You do not need to install anything to view or manage games.
TutorialPage.installDescription: Keep it on your home screen and receive notifications on your phone.
TutorialPage.installStepsIntro: Choose the instructions for your device and browser.
TutorialPage.androidIntro: On Android, an automatic prompt to install the app may appear. If it does not, follow the steps for your browser.
TutorialPage.chromeStep2: Tap the three-dot menu (⋮) next to the address bar, then choose Add to Home screen.
TutorialPage.chromeStep3: Tap Install and follow the confirmation on screen.
TutorialPage.samsungStep1: Open Voley Lisboa in Samsung Internet.
TutorialPage.samsungStep2: Tap the + icon in the address bar. If it is not there, open the menu and choose Add page to > Home screen.
TutorialPage.samsungStep3: Confirm that you want to add the app to your home screen.
TutorialPage.iosIntro: On iOS, the automatic installation prompt does not appear. Add the app to your home screen manually.
TutorialPage.safariStep2: Tap Share in the browser toolbar.
TutorialPage.safariStep3: Scroll through the list, then choose Add to Home Screen.
TutorialPage.safariStep4: Turn on Open as Web App if the option appears, then tap Add.
TutorialPage.iosChromeStep2: Tap Share to the right of the address bar.
TutorialPage.iosChromeStep4: Confirm the details, then tap Add.
TutorialPage.notificationsIntro: After installing, open the app from your home screen. A prompt to enable notifications for game reminders, payment-proof requests, and open spots may appear. If it does not, you can enable notifications in your profile.
TutorialPage.notificationsNote: Notifications are optional and you can change them later in your profile. In the same place, you can turn off email notifications whenever you no longer want alerts in your inbox.
TutorialPage.usageIntro: After you sign in, you will find upcoming games on the dashboard. Follow these steps to secure your place and arrive prepared.
TutorialPage.findGameIntro: On the dashboard, see the next game and other scheduled games. Tap a game to open its details, check open spots, players, and the waitlist.
TutorialPage.joinAndPayTitle: Join the game and add your proof
TutorialPage.joinAndPayIntro: When a spot is available, tap Join game. A payment-proof window opens: choose a file to add it straight away, or tap Add later to confirm your place first.
TutorialPage.joinAndPayNote: Add or replace your proof from the game details. We accept JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF files up to 5 MB.
TutorialPage.waitlistTitle: Join the waitlist when a game is full
TutorialPage.waitlistIntro: When a game is full, tap Join waitlist. When a spot opens, the person first on the waitlist is added to the game automatically and receives an alert if notifications or email updates are enabled.
TutorialPage.waitlistNote: After you are promoted, open the game details and add your payment proof before the game starts.
TutorialPage.leaveGameTitle: Leave a game if you can no longer attend
TutorialPage.leaveGameIntro: In the game details, tap Leave game and confirm. The spot becomes available to the next person on the waitlist and your proof is no longer linked to the game.
TutorialPage.gameDayIntro: In the game details, use Add to Google Calendar to save the date, time, and location. You can also use Share game to send the link directly to other players.
